items.question: Where is Ixlos School located?
items.answer: Ixlos School is located in Tashkent's Yunusabad district at Bog'ishamol ko'chasi, 219 (Toshkent, Yunusobod tumani, Bog'ishamol ko'chasi, 219-uy). Hours are 08:00–18:00; phone: +998 78 113 36 00.

items.question: Which grades are admitted and how does admission work?
items.answer: Students are admitted from grade 1 through grade 11. Everyone takes a test in Mathematics and English and has an interview with the school psychologist; the pass mark is at least 60. Grades 1–4 have Uzbek- and Russian-medium groups.

items.question: Is it a full-day school? Meals, transport and daily schedule
items.answer: Yes. Classes run Monday to Friday from 08:30 to 17:00. Students have three meals a day — breakfast, lunch and an afternoon snack — from a specially prepared menu, attend free clubs after the main lessons, and a school bus serves students who live far away. Students wear the designated school uniform.

items.question: Are mathematics and English taught in depth?
items.answer: Yes. In grades 5–9, mathematics, English and informatics are taught in depth. Students are placed in A, B and C groups by proficiency, and groups are updated after weekly exams. Saturday catch-up classes are held for students who fall behind. Graduates are guaranteed an IELTS score of at least 5.5.

items.question: Does the school teach IT and programming?
items.answer: Informatics is taught in depth in grades 5–9, and grades 10–11 offer an IT track that leads to a professional diploma. There is also a free IT and coding club after the main lessons.

items.question: Is there a finance and accounting track in grades 10–11? What do graduates receive?
items.answer: Yes. Grades 10–11 offer Accounting and IT tracks, along with the international ACCA and SAT programs. Along with the school certificate, graduates receive a professional diploma and are guaranteed an IELTS score of at least 5.5.

items.question: In which language are primary grades taught?
items.answer: In grades 1–4, fundamental education is delivered in Russian- and Uzbek-medium groups.

items.question: Are the clubs paid?
items.answer: No, all clubs (Mental Arithmetic, Chess, Arabic, Robotics, IT & Coding, Speech Therapy, Football, Judo) are free and included in the tuition fee.

items.question: How much does tuition cost and how can it be paid?
items.answer: Tuition depends on the grade level. It can be paid annually or monthly. For current prices, call +998 78 113 36 00 or leave an application.

items.question: Are there benefits for high-achieving students?
items.answer: Yes, students with high quarterly results study on a monthly scholarship basis.

faq.question: Is Ixlos School an IT school?
faq.answer: Ixlos School is a private general-education school (grades 1–11) that specializes in finance and IT. It is not a coding course or academy: students receive a full general secondary education, and IT is taught as in-depth informatics in grades 5–9 and as a separate track in grades 10–11.

faq.question: From which grade is informatics taught in depth?
faq.answer: From grade 5 to grade 9. Mathematics and English are also taught in depth in these grades.

faq.question: What does a graduate of the IT track in grades 10–11 receive?
faq.answer: A professional diploma in IT along with the school certificate. Graduates are also guaranteed an IELTS score of at least 5.5.

faq.question: Are the IT and Robotics clubs paid?
faq.answer: No. The IT & Coding and Robotics clubs, like the school's other clubs, are free and included in tuition. They run after the main lessons.

faq.question: How are Mathematics and English taught alongside IT?
faq.answer: Mathematics and English are also taught in depth in grades 5–9. Students who are falling behind have extra classes on Saturdays: in Mathematics and English in the upper grades.

faq.question: How do students get into the IT track?
faq.answer: Admission is the same for every grade: a test in Mathematics and English plus an interview with the school psychologist, with a pass mark of at least 60. To start, leave an application on this page.
